pages.text: This book covers everything in $(thing)Masteri's Black Hole Energy$(): how to build a dark energy reactor, run it for power, and keep it from $(danger)melting down$(), and what's waiting past it: dark energy zones and the $(l:event_horizon/getting_there)Event Horizon$().$(br2)Click any $(l:building/full_reactor)blue link$() to jump between entries.
Multiblock pages have an $(thing)eye button$(). Press it to project a ghost of the structure into your world, then build over it.$(br2)Lost your copy? Craft a new one.
pages.title: Using this book

pages.text: Every player gets one on their first join.
